# Self Improvement Loop

> Rejection-sampling self-training with a verifier, built from scratch: a policy that learns to solve reasoning puzzles from its own verified successes, with no human labels.

Languages: Python. License: MIT. Source: https://github.com/adeoluo/self-improvement-loop

## Source

- [src/self_improvement_loop/__init__.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/self-improvement-loop/blob/main/src/self_improvement_loop/__init__.py): Self Improvement Loop - recursive self-training with a verifier, from scratch.
- [src/self_improvement_loop/cli.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/self-improvement-loop/blob/main/src/self_improvement_loop/cli.py): Command line interface for the self-improvement loop.
- [src/self_improvement_loop/data.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/self-improvement-loop/blob/main/src/self_improvement_loop/data.py): Deterministic puzzle generation and fixed train and test splits.
- [src/self_improvement_loop/environment.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/self-improvement-loop/blob/main/src/self_improvement_loop/environment.py): The reasoning task, its verifier, and an exact oracle solver.
- [src/self_improvement_loop/evaluation.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/self-improvement-loop/blob/main/src/self_improvement_loop/evaluation.py): Evaluation: greedy accuracy, sampled pass@k, and solution quality.
- [src/self_improvement_loop/generation.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/self-improvement-loop/blob/main/src/self_improvement_loop/generation.py): Trace generation: sampled rollouts, greedy decoding, and rationalization.
- [src/self_improvement_loop/observability.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/self-improvement-loop/blob/main/src/self_improvement_loop/observability.py): In-process request metrics for the HTTP service (Prometheus text exposition).
- [src/self_improvement_loop/policy.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/self-improvement-loop/blob/main/src/self_improvement_loop/policy.py): A log-linear policy over actions, trained from scratch by behavior cloning.
- [src/self_improvement_loop/self_improvement.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/self-improvement-loop/blob/main/src/self_improvement_loop/self_improvement.py): The self-improvement loop: generate, verify, filter, and clone.
- [src/self_improvement_loop/service.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/self-improvement-loop/blob/main/src/self_improvement_loop/service.py): A standard-library HTTP service exposing the self-trained policy.
